_what: Stage 00b intake gate (PIPELINE_V2.md section 3). Every panel or table that could supply a corpus value, with the tier it came from. Filled BEFORE any digitiser was written.

paper.title_as_published: Carbonate-Bearing Ionizable Lipids for mRNA Delivery to Splenic NK Cells
paper.title_in_tracker: Carbonate-Bearing Ionizable Lipids for mRNA Delivery to Spleen...
paper.title_note: The tracker title is TRUNCATED. The endpoint is mRNA delivery to splenic NK CELLS, not to the spleen as an organ. Verified on SI p.1 and against the Crossref and Europe PMC records, which both carry the full title.
paper.proposed_experiment_id_note: FREE, verified by enumerating every Experiment_ID in both corpus files: the corpus holds SL_2020 (91 rows) and SL_2021 (572 rows) and no SL_2025, and no experiment of any initials carries the year 2025 under these initials. 54 distinct Experiment_IDs exist in all. CORRECTION: the first version of this file asserted that SL_2025 collided with SL_2021 and was therefore blocked. That was MY error and it was never checked before being written -- INITIALS_YEAR makes 2021 and 2025 distinct keys, and the _2 suffix convention is for a second screen from ONE paper, which is not this situation. Recorded rather than silently deleted, per CLAUDE.md section 6 'treat reviewer findings as claims'; the claim here was my own.

endpoint.primary_in_vitro: Firefly luciferase activity (RLU), IGROV1 human ovarian cancer cells, 25 ng Fluc mRNA per well, 24 h, Bio-Lumi II kit. SI p.7.
endpoint.primary_in_vivo: IVIS bioluminescence, average radiance [p/sec/cm^2/sr], C57BL/6 mice, intravenous, 6 h post-dose, D-luciferin 30 mg/mL 100 uL i.p. 5 min before imaging. SI p.11.
endpoint.cell_type_claim: Splenic NK cells, established by Cre mRNA / Ai9 tdTomato flow cytometry (Fig S32), not by a luminescence readout.
endpoint.corpus_relevance: The luciferase and average-radiance readouts are comparable in KIND to the corpus luminescence_normalized rows. The pKa, size, zeta, PDI, encapsulation, lipid-fusion, viability and Cy5-uptake panels are NOT delivery endpoints and are out of scope per the corpus's delivery-only definition (CLAUDE.md section 9, 2026-07-23).

tier_1_publisher_source_data.checkable_sentence: Crossref returns total-results = 0 for filter=doi:10.1021/jacs.5c01389,type:component, and the work record carries no 'component' relation and no link other than two entries pointing at https://pubs.acs.org/doi/pdf/10.1021/jacs.5c01389. ACS publishes no Source Data file for this article.

tier_2_si_tables.checkable_sentence: The SI has 54 pages and 37 figures (S1-S37) and NO numbered table. Its own Table of Contents lists exactly three sections: Experimental Procedures (p.2), Supplementary Figures (p.13), Supplementary References (p.54). The two objects that LOOK like tables, Figure S25A (16 formulations A-1..A-16) and Figure S27A (5 formulations B-9..B-13), are pixels inside a flattened figure raster, not text (see tier 4).

tier_3_author_repo.checkable_sentence: No find_repo.py exists anywhere in this repository (`find -name find_repo.py` returns nothing), so the search was run by hand: GitHub repository search for 'jacs.5c01389' returns total_count 0, for 'carbonate+ionizable+lipid+spleen' returns total_count 0, and for 'An-CE-Cm' returns 45 unrelated electronics/Ceph repositories. Zenodo returns hits 0 for '"jacs.5c01389"' and hits 0 for '"carbonate-bearing ionizable lipids"'. The SI contains no data-availability statement and no accession, URL or repository name.

tier_3b_full_text.checkable_sentence: Europe PMC search on DOI:"10.1021/jacs.5c01389" returns hitCount 1 with isOpenAccess=N, inEPMC=N, inPMC=N, hasSuppl=N, and a single fullTextUrl whose availability is 'Subscription required'. We hold the SI only. No paywall bypass was attempted.

tier_4_pdfplumber.checkable_sentence: pdfplumber.extract_tables() was run over all 54 pages and returned 11 objects, every one of which is mis-segmented body prose from pages 2, 9, 10 and 41 (e.g. [['The','','microplate','','reader',...]]); not one is a data table. PyMuPDF confirms why: every page from 13 to 54 carries zero vector drawing items and exactly one embedded raster image, except p.41 (21 rects, the Figure S29D protein-corona panel frame) and the FACS pages 43-50. All 37 figures, including the two formulation tables, are flattened JPEGs.

licence.checkable_sentence: Crossref lists three licence URLs for this work, all content-version 'stm-asf': 10.15223/policy-029, policy-037 and policy-045. These are the ACS standard-licence policies, not CC0 or CC-BY. CLAUDE.md section 8 requires constituent-source licences to be CC0/CC-BY-compatible before corpus release; this source is not, and that is recorded for that decision rather than resolved here.

WHERE_THE_VALUES_ARE: The 161-member An-CE-Cm library screen is NOT in the SI. The SI's in vitro screen (IGROV1) and in vivo screen are both referred to but never shown here; the library's per-member values live in main-text Figures 1-3, which we do not hold and cannot obtain. What the SI does carry is a small number of named, individually measured representative lipids, in three panels, all of which must be digitised from pixels.

panels.what: In vitro mRNA delivery, luciferase activity (RLU), IGROV1. 4 bars, mean +/- s.d., n = 3.
panels.axis: log10, 10^4 to 10^8, five labelled decade ticks
panels.why_tiers_1_to_4_failed: See external_tiers_checked: ACS publishes no Source Data (Crossref components = 0), the SI has no table of any kind, no repository exists on GitHub or Zenodo, and pdfplumber finds zero real tables because page 34 is a single flattened JPEG with zero vector items.

panels.what: In vivo mRNA delivery, average radiance [p/sec/cm^2/sr]. TWO SEPARATE PANELS, 2 bars each, mean +/- s.d., n = 3, Fluc mRNA 0.25 mg/kg.
panels.axis: log10, 10^4 to 10^8, five labelled decade ticks, drawn independently on each panel
panels.emittable: BLOCKED - the organ is never stated. See DECISIONS.md D-2.
panels.trap_4_note: Two panels sharing no member, so no lipid-level ratio between them can be measured. Their two axis calibrations are compared instead; they are NOT pooled into one block.

panels.what: Spleen/liver mRNA expression ratio, A5 series, 11 labelled lipids, single points (no error bars), Fluc mRNA 0.25 mg/kg.
panels.axis: log10, 10^0 to 10^3, four labelled decade ticks
panels.emittable: NO - this is a RATIO of two organs, a selectivity contrast, not a delivery magnitude. CLAUDE.md section 8 already rules a selectivity contrast (molea's mTP_Difference) non-poolable. Digitised and reported anyway because it is the ONLY panel in the SI that individually measures more than four library members. See DECISIONS.md D-1.

panels_examined_and_rejected.why: Cell viability. Not a delivery endpoint; the corpus excludes it (the 90 hemolysis_percent rows precedent).

In vivo delivery, but the only readout is four IVIS organ RASTERS with a colour bar and no per-organ number. Trap 3: a heat map with no numeric scale per item is not extractable. The drawn STRUCTURES on this page are used, as the C10 anchor source.
Same: IVIS rasters only, re-used from main-text Fig 3G at a different scale bar.
Spleen/liver RATIO, 4 lipids, n = 2. Same contrast objection as S5, with a smaller n.
Size, PDI, zeta, encapsulation, lipid fusion, viability. None is a delivery endpoint.
Cy5 cellular UPTAKE. The corpus's in-vivo definition explicitly excludes uptake (CLAUDE.md section 9, 2026-07-23); all four bars are at ~99% and carry no discrimination anyway.

THE ORTHOGONAL-ARRAY TRAP. S25A tabulates 16 formulations (A-1..A-16) of ONE lipid, A5-CE-C7-6. S25B does NOT plot those 16 values: it plots 16 MARGINAL MEANS over four factors at four levels each, so every plotted point is an average of four formulations. Zero of the 16 formulations is individually reported. See 08_contradictions.csv row on distinct-vs-measured.
IVIS rasters only, one lipid at two weight ratios.
S27A is a 5-row formulation table (B-9..B-13) in pixels; S27B is IVIS rasters only, no quantification.
IVIS rasters only, five cholesterol levels of one lipid. S28B-D are size/zeta/encapsulation.
FACS gating strategies. No delivery magnitude.
Splenic cell-type transfection percentages (n = 2) and protein corona. A cell-type composition, not a per-lipid delivery magnitude.
Serum and storage stability of one lipid over time. A time course of one formulation, not a library readout.

three_different_numbers._why: Trap 1. Distinct structures, formulations and individually measured members are three different numbers.
three_different_numbers.formulations_described: 26+ (A-1..A-16 orthogonal array, B-4..B-13, plus the 15/20/25/2 screening formulation and the MC3 Spleen SORT control). Figures 4C and 3 of the main text, which we do not hold, define several of them.
three_different_numbers.individually_measured_delivery_values_no: 8 = 4 bars in S22C + 4 bars in S24, over 4 distinct ionizable lipids. The 11 points in S5 are a ratio, not a delivery magnitude. The 161-member library contributes ZERO individually reported values to the SI.
